description.en: Sets the currently-triggered NPC encounter's index, so the engine knows which encounter data (used to start its associated challenge) to use next.
Index of the encounter to set as active.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Mark an encounter as the active one before starting its challenge
CMND_SET_ENCOUNT_INFO(ecnIdx);
